description: Every infinite \(L\)-structure has an elementarily equivalent structure of cardinality exactly \(\kappa\) for every \(\kappa\ge\max(\aleph_0,|L|)\).
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.exists_elementarilyEquivalent_card_eq.{u, v, w, w'} (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type w')
  [L.Structure M] [Infinite M] (κ : Cardinal.{w}) (h1 : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (h2 : Cardinal.lift.{w, max u v} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v, w} κ) :
  ∃ N, L.ElementarilyEquivalent M ↑N ∧ Cardinal.mk ↑N = κ
